author: Codex
authorization_literal: Dale, empieza por conciliar la exposición y revisar los 36 siniestros sin periodo. Prepara el objetivo y las particiones de validación, y deja las decisiones en el foro antes de entrenar.

exposure.basis: inclusive actual covered days / 365, rounded to 4 decimals

claims.precoverage_rule: loss_date < minimum available period_start for same market,line,policy_id
claims.unmatched_handling: retain all in audit; precoverage excluded from current-period target, not forcibly reassigned

target.meaning: observed net incurred for accepted uniquely assigned claims as at 2024-12-31, not observed ultimate
target.money_calculation: integer cents; no repeat deduction of policy excess

reserve_stresses.type: design sensitivity only, not fitted reserve development

target.ultimate_adjustment: not estimated in this preparation; reporting and reserve uncertainty remain explicit

validation.group_definition: connected components of customer-address edges from emerging training periods 2023-2024, shared across all lines; no targets and no test-2025 edges
validation.group_id: SHA256 of lexicographic smallest namespaced node in component
validation.fold_assignment: SHA256(seed + | + group_id), first 8 bytes big-endian mod 5
validation.development: 5 group folds within 2023; calibration uses cross-fitted development predictions only
validation.temporal: fit 2023, evaluate 2024 once candidate choices frozen; repeated entities allowed and tagged as realistic renewals
validation.cold_start: for k=0..4 fit 2023 groups with fold != k; evaluate 2024 groups with fold == k, no shared customer/address
validation.production: all labeled 2023-2024 after final choice; 2025 remains unlabelled
validation.selection_note: 2024 labels inspected for data reconciliation; no model or score consulted; not a fully prospective historical backtest because valuation is shared

acceptance: Input SHA256 unchanged before and after
Every exposure equals calendar rule; only declared 609 changes
Every raw claim accounted once; no ambiguity; all 36 excluded claims before first available coverage
Integer-cent reconciliation accepted = assigned + precoverage for every monetary component
Row-complete target: one per training row; no target in test
Group membership independent of target; no entity overlap in inner and cold folds
All folds contain rows and positive target cases for each line; report balance without reseeding on labels
No estimator fitting, calibration, model inference, submissions or remote jobs
